heading: Where small CIS shops actually live

1c-bitrix.name: 1C-Bitrix
1c-bitrix.text: The most used store engine in Russia (about 29% of shops, though over half run a custom CMS). Bitrix24 has official MCP servers; for the store engine we found only third-party developer tools.

opencart.name: OpenCart
opencart.text: A separate store CMS, not a WordPress plugin. No official MCP; third-party extensions exist, such as EcomAiBridge in the OpenCart marketplace.

wordpress-woocommerce.name: WordPress + WooCommerce
wordpress-woocommerce.text: WordPress has an official MCP Adapter, and WooCommerce ships an MCP integration since 10.3. Both are still early: WooCommerce calls it a developer preview.

lead: Most small shops run on WooCommerce, OpenCart or 1C-Bitrix, not on Shopify. None of them gives a ready shopping agent out of the box. Pleiades is a widget on the page, so it does not wait for the CMS to become agent-ready.
